description: Planned menu-family × native-state × VR-presentation obligations. These are not an enumeration of every native page. Discover and retain each child page, legal choice and transition before claiming complete menu coverage.

modes.title: Title / helicopter cabin
modes.emplacement: Turret / mortar station; split by native role during discovery
modes.walker: Walker Gear / D-Walker; split by native role during discovery
modes.results: Mission clear / abort results; split during discovery

acceptance: Record exact native state, page, parent page, selected choice, enabled/locked choices and eligibility; an open-menu flag is insufficient.
Use the effective VR bindings and observe the actual page/choice response, including tab changes, scrolling, cursor edges and map pan/zoom where applicable.
Visit every discovered child page and legal confirmation/cancel branch. Verify actual action completion; delivered input alone is insufficient.
Back out from each depth, close, immediately reopen, and verify locomotion/combat input ownership and neutral controls recover.
Review complete final-eye sequences for both eyes: readable text, uncropped choices, correct attachment, head/hand motion and stable stereo without blinking.
Confirm physical-headset reading, controller usability, scale and comfort separately from simulator observations.
safety: Read-only discovery first. Purchases, upgrades, deployment, abort/retry and progression-changing confirmations require an isolated verified save/checkpoint fixture. An ambiguous page never admits generic Confirm or repeated Back.

Pause choices and all nested options

iDroid map, markers, lists and map controls

Online / FOB menu eligibility and entry/cancel branches; network gameplay unaccepted

limits: Applicability is not established for planned menu/state pairs. Native unavailability must be observed; it is never inferred from a missing adapter.
Progression, buddy, equipment, vehicle subtype, tutorial and confirmation variants must be discovered and retained as distinct child paths.
TPP online menu branches remain open. MGO and Ground Zeroes are separate game adapters, not covered by a TPP menu pass.
No matrix count is a percentage of the game's actual menus. Menu discovery and physical-headset acceptance remain incomplete.
